ilike

Implementations of a number of ABC algorithms and pseudo-marginal methods for dynamic models. Documentation at https://richardgeveritt.github.io/ilike_documentation/

Installation

ilike is installed from source, so it needs a working compiler toolchain for R, including the Fortran libraries that R links against (ilike uses LAPACK via RcppArmadillo), and the HDF5 C library.

1. Install the compiler toolchain

macOS

  1. Install the Xcode command line tools:

    xcode-select --install

  2. Install the gfortran build that CRAN uses, from https://mac.r-project.org/tools/. It installs into /opt/gfortran, which is where R looks for the Fortran libraries. The gfortran version must match the one your R was built with: run

    R CMD config FLIBS

    and look at the version number in the first path, e.g. -L/opt/gfortran/lib/gcc/aarch64-apple-darwin20.0/14.2.0 means gfortran 14.2 (used by R 4.5 and later). An older gfortran in /opt/gfortran gives the same linker errors as a missing one; the CRAN page explains how to remove it before installing the right version.

    Homebrew’s gfortran (brew install gcc) is not a substitute: it lives in a different place, so linking fails with errors such as

    ld: warning: search path '/opt/gfortran/lib' not found
ld: library 'emutls_w' not found

    (You can see where R expects the libraries with R CMD config FLIBS.)

Linux

Install R’s development toolchain, which includes gfortran, e.g. sudo apt-get install r-base-dev (Debian / Ubuntu) or sudo dnf install R-devel (Fedora / RHEL).

Windows

Install Rtools matching your R version; it includes the compilers and Fortran libraries.

2. Install the HDF5 system library

ilike requires the HDF5 C library. Install it for your platform before installing the R package.

macOS

brew install hdf5

Linux (Debian / Ubuntu)

sudo apt-get install libhdf5-dev

Linux (Fedora / RHEL / CentOS)

sudo dnf install hdf5-devel

Windows

HDF5 is distributed via the Rtools toolchain. Open an Rtools MSYS2 shell (e.g. C:\rtools45\ucrt64.exe) and run:

pacman -Sy mingw-w64-x86_64-hdf5

Note: Rtools must already be installed. pacman is the package manager bundled with Rtools 4.x.

If you upgrade HDF5 to a new major version later (e.g. with brew upgrade hdf5), reinstall ilike so that it links against the new library.

3. Install ilike 

# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("richardgeveritt/ilike")
